conventions.all_subsumption: every parent clause subsumed by at least one derived clause; reuse permitted

vectors.title: Minimal valid root token, single-token chain
vectors.description: Root issued by the trust anchor to the Orchestrator; read_file with a wildcard path. Presented alone (root = leaf) with a PoP from the Orchestrator.

vectors.title: Valid 3-level chain
vectors.description: Root (Control Plane -> Orchestrator, del_max_depth 3) -> L1 (Orchestrator -> Worker, one_of narrowed, range max 100 -> 20, wildcard -> exact, del_max_depth 2) -> L2 (Worker -> Worker2, one_of -> exact, search_index dropped, terminal: del_depth == del_max_depth == 2).

vectors.title: PoP without aat_aud, verifier requires audience
vectors.description: Same chain as J.3; the PoP omits aat_aud. The vector's deployment policy requires audience binding.
notes: -02: aat_aud is REQUIRED. Under draft-01 text a verifier with no audience policy would PERMIT (Warden NOTES entry 8).

vectors.title: PoP aat_aud does not identify this enforcement point
vectors.description: Same chain as J.3; aat_aud is present but names https://evil.example.com.

vectors.title: PoP JWT missing typ
vectors.description: PoP is otherwise valid but its header is {"alg":"EdDSA"} with no typ.

vectors.title: AAT presented where a PoP is expected (type confusion)
vectors.description: The PoP slot carries a token with typ aat+jwt, signed by Worker2 with aat_* claims present. Explicit typing rejects it before the claims are examined.

vectors.title: AAT with typ aat-pop+jwt in the chain
vectors.description: The root token is signed by the trust anchor but typed as a PoP.

vectors.title: AAT missing typ
vectors.description: Root is otherwise valid but its header is {"alg":"EdDSA"} with no typ.

vectors.title: I1 violation: derived token signed by a key that does not hold the parent
vectors.description: L1 is signed by the Attacker and honestly sets iss to the Attacker's thumbprint URI. Signature verification under parent.cnf.jwk fails before the iss comparison is reached.

vectors.title: I1 violation: iss claims the parent holder but signature is the Attacker's
vectors.description: Same as J.4 but iss is forged to the Orchestrator's thumbprint URI. Still fails at 4b.

vectors.title: I1 violation: signature verifies, iss is not the parent holder thumbprint
vectors.description: L1 is signed by the Orchestrator (parent holder) so 4b passes; iss is the Attacker's thumbprint URI.

vectors.title: Expired root token
vectors.description: Root exp = 1704067400, verification time = 1704067500.

vectors.title: I2 violation: del_depth skips a level
vectors.description: L1 declares del_depth 2 under a root at depth 0.

vectors.title: I2 violation: del_max_depth raised above parent
vectors.description: L1 declares del_max_depth 4 under a root with del_max_depth 3.

vectors.title: I2 violation: derivation from a terminal token
vectors.description: L2 in J.3 is terminal (del_depth == del_max_depth == 2). L3 is a correctly signed child of it.

vectors.title: I4 violation: one_of widened
vectors.description: L1 adds /data/secret.pdf to read_file.path.

vectors.title: I4 violation: tool not present in parent
vectors.description: L1 adds delete_file, which the root never authorized.

vectors.title: I4 violation: constraint key dropped from a closed-world map
vectors.description: L1 drops search_index.limit. §4.5 requires the exact same key set when the parent map is non-empty.

vectors.title: I4 violation: one_of relaxed to wildcard
vectors.description: A derived wildcard is valid only under a parent wildcard.

vectors.title: I5 violation: par_hash over a different parent
vectors.description: L1 is a valid child of the J.3 root in every respect except par_hash, which is SHA-256 of the J.1 root's signing input. Both roots have the same holder key, so only I5 catches the splice.

vectors.title: I5 violation: par_hash over the payload segment only
vectors.description: par_hash is SHA-256 of BASE64URL(payload) instead of the full JWS Signing Input (header || '.' || payload). A common implementation mistake.

vectors.title: I3 violation: derived exp beyond parent exp
vectors.description: L1 exp = root exp + 3600.

vectors.title: I3 violation: derived iat earlier than parent iat
vectors.description: L1 iat = root iat - 1.

vectors.title: Invalid signature: one bit flipped in the root signature
vectors.description: Header and payload are byte-identical to the J.3 root.

vectors.title: alg: none rejected unconditionally
vectors.description: Same payload as the J.3 root with header {"alg":"none"} and an empty signature (§8.13).

vectors.title: PoP signed by the wrong holder key
vectors.description: Valid J.3 chain; PoP signed by the Attacker instead of Worker2.

vectors.title: PoP aat_id references a different token
vectors.description: PoP signed correctly by Worker2 but aat_id is the L1 jti.

vectors.title: Leaf exact rejects invocation args before PoP hta is compared
vectors.description: PoP commits to {path: q3}; the invocation presents {path: q4}. Denied at 6b because q4 fails the L2 exact constraint. Step 7f is not reached. J.20.5 is the actual hta-mismatch case.

vectors.title: PoP iat outside the clock window
vectors.description: PoP iat = now - 31 with a ±30 s window.

vectors.title: PoP hta does not match invocation args
vectors.description: Leaf is the J.3 root (read_file.path is one_of[q3, q4]). Invocation path is q3, which passes step 6b. PoP hta commits to q4, so 7f fails.

vectors.title: PoP aat_tool does not match the invocation tool
vectors.description: Prefix [L0, L1] authorizes both read_file and search_index. Invocation is search_index with valid args; PoP aat_tool is read_file. Step 6b passes; 7e fails. hta matches the invocation so 7f is not the cause.

vectors.title: Closed-world: unconstrained extra argument
vectors.description: Leaf constrains only path; invocation adds mode.

vectors.title: Closed-world: constrained argument absent
vectors.description: Leaf constrains path; invocation omits it.

vectors.title: Tool dropped at L2 cannot be invoked
vectors.description: search_index is authorized at L0 and L1 but was dropped at L2.

vectors.title: Prefix presentation of a valid chain
vectors.description: Only [L0, L1] of the J.3 chain is presented, with a PoP from the Worker (L1 holder) on search_index. This is a valid chain in its own right; the leaf is L1.
notes: NOTES entry 6 in the Warden repo: prefix presentation is permitted and relies entirely on PoP.

vectors.title: Duplicate jti in chain (cycle detection, step 2c)
vectors.description: L1 reuses the root's jti. Detected before any signature is verified.

vectors.title: all: derived adds a clause
vectors.description: limit: all[max 100, min 0] -> all[max 100, min 0, min 1].

vectors.title: all: derived drops a parent clause
vectors.description: limit: all[max 100, min 0] -> all[max 100]. Dropping widens.

vectors.title: all: one derived clause covers two parent clauses
vectors.description: limit: all[max 100, min 0] -> all[min 10 max 50]. The single derived range is narrower than both parent clauses. PERMIT under the agreed -02 rule (Tenuo's); draft-01's one-to-one text would DENY.
notes: Warden interop case all-clause-reuse-two-parents-one-derived. Soundness: C_d ⊑ C_p1 and C_d ⊑ C_p2 implies C_d ⊑ C_p1 ∧ C_p2, so no one-to-one assignment is needed.

vectors.title: all: one exact covers two parent wildcards
vectors.description: limit: all[wildcard, wildcard] -> all[exact 5]. Minimal shape of the clause-reuse rule.

vectors.title: all: a derived clause fails subsumption
vectors.description: limit: all[max 100, min 0] -> all[max 200, min 0].

vectors.title: all: leaf check evaluates every clause
vectors.description: Valid derivation; invocation limit 0 fails min 1.

vectors.title: any: derived removes alternatives
vectors.description: format: any[pdf, csv, xlsx] -> any[pdf, csv].

vectors.title: any: derived adds an alternative
vectors.description: format: any[pdf, csv, xlsx] -> any[pdf, docx]. §4.5 example.

vectors.title: any: empty derived any
vectors.description: format: any[...] -> any[]. §4.5: derived any MUST contain at least one clause.

vectors.title: any: leaf check accepts a listed alternative
vectors.description: Valid any[pdf, csv]; invocation format csv.

vectors.title: any: leaf check rejects a removed alternative
vectors.description: Valid any[pdf, csv]; invocation format xlsx.

vectors.title: any: cross-type clause subsumption
vectors.description: format: any[one_of[pdf, csv], exact xlsx] -> any[exact pdf]. exact pdf ⊑ one_of[pdf, csv] per the cross-type rules.

vectors.title: Empty parent map: derived introduces constraint keys (step 4p3)
vectors.description: Root authorizes read_file with an empty constraint map. L1 introduces path:exact. §4.5 / step 4p3 permits adding keys when the parent map is empty.

vectors.title: Empty tool map at the leaf: extra arguments are permitted
vectors.description: Root = leaf, read_file has an empty constraint map. Closed-world mode is off, so extra args PERMIT.

vectors.title: Unknown constraint_type is fail-closed at the leaf
vectors.description: Root carries path:{constraint_type: no_such_type}. Step 6b denies unrecognized types.
notes: The draft fixes the outcome, not the step: a verifier that validates constraint types while walking the tree at step 3n will report 3n instead of 6b. Both are conformant.

vectors.title: Flatten all to a bare range is rejected even when the range is narrower
vectors.description: Parent limit is all[min 0, max 100]. Derived is range(min 10, max 50), not wrapped in all. Same-type wrapping is required; undeclared (all, range) is invalid.
notes: Conservative by design: the derived range is semantically narrower, but (all, range) is an undeclared pair and §4.5 rejects every undeclared pair. tenuo-core agrees (IncompatibleConstraintTypes).

vectors.title: not_one_of: derived adds an exclusion
vectors.description: label: not_one_of[secret, internal] -> not_one_of[secret, internal, embargoed].

vectors.title: not_one_of: derived drops an exclusion
vectors.description: label: not_one_of[secret, internal] -> not_one_of[secret]. Removing an exclusion widens.

vectors.title: contains: derived adds a required element
vectors.description: tags: contains[public] -> contains[public, reviewed].

vectors.title: contains: derived drops a required element
vectors.description: tags: contains[public] -> contains[]. Removing a required element widens.

vectors.title: subset: derived shrinks the allowed set
vectors.description: roles: subset[reader, editor, admin] -> subset[reader, editor].

vectors.title: subset: derived adds an allowed element
vectors.description: roles: subset[reader, editor, admin] -> subset[reader, editor, admin, owner]. Adding widens.

vectors.title: range: exclusive derived bound at the same min is tighter
vectors.description: limit: range[0, 100] inclusive -> range[0, 100] with min_inclusive false.

vectors.title: range: inclusive derived bound under an exclusive parent widens
vectors.description: Parent limit is range[0, 100] with min_inclusive false. Derived uses the default inclusive min=0.

vectors.title: derived all under parent any is rejected
vectors.description: format: any[pdf, csv, xlsx] -> all[exact pdf]. (all, any) is an undeclared pair.
notes: Conservative by design: all[exact pdf] is semantically narrower than the parent any, but the pair is undeclared. tenuo-core agrees (IncompatibleConstraintTypes).

vectors.title: nested all[any[...]]: derived removes an alternative
vectors.description: format: all[any[pdf, csv, xlsx]] -> all[any[pdf]]. Inner any narrows; outer all is preserved.

vectors.title: Root token carries par_hash
vectors.description: A root MUST NOT contain par_hash (step 3d).

vectors.title: Root token del_depth is not 0
vectors.description: A root MUST have del_depth == 0 (step 3c).

vectors.title: cnf.jwk contains private key material
vectors.description: Root cnf.jwk includes the Ed25519 d parameter. Step 3l requires a public key.
notes: The d value is the Orchestrator's published test seed (32 x 0x02), not a secret.

vectors.title: Root iat is more than MAX_IAT_SKEW in the future
vectors.description: iat = now + 31, MAX_IAT_SKEW = 30 (step 3f).

vectors.title: Root lifetime exceeds MAX_TOKEN_LIFETIME
vectors.description: exp = iat + 90 days + 1 (step 3h).
